content:
alex_support: Customer (AcmeCorp) reporting 400 from /v1/tool/invoke + intermittent 3-8s lat spikes. Error mentions JSON schema validation: additionalProperties on billing_profile and missing required customer_id. trace_id=t-9ab3.

devin_oncall: Can you paste full response body and the payload they sent? Also SDK version if available.

alex_support: Response body (sanitized):
```
{\n  \"error\": \"validation_error\",\n  \"details\": [\n    {\"path\": \"billing_profile\", \"error\": \"additionalProperties\"},\n    {\"path\": \"customer_id\", \"error\": \"required\"}\n  ]\n}\n```
They say they're using python-sdk v1.2.0. Customer payload they sent (sanitized):
```
{\n  \"tool\": \"create_invoice\",\n  \"args\": {\n    \"amount\": 1000,\n    \"currency\": \"USD\",\n    \"billing_profile\": \"acct_123\",  # sent as string not object\n    \"session_id\": 987654321  # sent as number but schema expects string\n  }\n}\n```

maria_engineer: Two separate validation issues here: (1) billing_profile is now rejected as additionalProperties because we tightened schema to expect an object, (2) customer_id required missing — likely their SDK mapping changed or they forgot to include it. Also note session_id type mismatch (number vs string).

sre_jan: I checked traces for t-9ab3 window — lots of retries from the customer side around the same time as validation errors, and an auth service 504 spike at 2026-03-15T14:22Z. That could explain latency amplification. Not sure if the validation rejections are causing retries or vice versa.

billing_team: Heads up — we deployed a stricter billing_profile schema yesterday that flips additionalProperties=false. Intention was to reduce free-form payloads, but we didn't add a backward-compatibility shim. Rolling this back in staging now.

devin_oncall: Proposed plan:
1) Ask customer for exact SDK call + headers (X-Request-ID / trace_id) and their full raw body.
2) Temporary compatibility: accept string billing_profile and coerce to {\"id\": <string>} on the adapter layer behind a feature-flag.
3) Add clearer validation errors with suggestion: \"if billing_profile is a string, provide {\"id\": \"...\"} or upgrade SDK\".
4) Investigate auth 504s correlation and reduce retry storm (client-side backoff guidance).

alex_support: I'll request the X-Request-ID and stacktrace from AcmeCorp and confirm SDK+version. I also have a repro with curl and same payload.

alex_support: Repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -H \"X-Request-ID: t-9ab3\" \\
  -d '{\"tool\":\"create_invoice\",\"args\":{\"amount\":1000,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"billing_profile\":\"acct_123\",\"session_id\":987654321}}'
```

maria_engineer: I'll open a small PR to the validator to accept string billing_profile and coerce it; will add unit tests and a feature flag. ETA ~2 hours. Tagging @sre_jan for rollout window.

billing_team: Rolling the schema rollback in staging now. If PR is ready we can canary it behind the feature flag and monitor errors + latency. :thumbsup:

sre_jan: For monitoring: add a temporary logging hook to count validation_error types and measure request->response lat distribution. If we see retries causing auth 504s, we throttle client retries via guidance in SDK.

alex_support: Thanks — I'll update AcmeCorp with the steps and ETA. If SLA impact is material I'll loop in the account exec. Will paste X-Request-ID + sanitized payload when they send it.

support-bot: Incident note: ticket #45678 created and linked to this thread.

devin_oncall: Assigning owner: maria_engineer for the compatibility PR, alex_support to coordinate with the customer, sre_jan to monitor rollout. Follow-ups in this thread.
